title: "Targetting Windies Top order" - Josh Hazlewood Interview | WI vs AUS, 2nd ODI - Press Conference
quote_text:
Fast bowler Josh Hazlewood says he and Mitchell Starc will go about their business as usual after destroying the West Indies top order in Barbados.

Hazelwood says the pair would stick to their tried and true approach when Australia tries to seal the CG Insurance ODI Series at Kensington Oval tomorrow.

Starc took yet another five-wicket haul to reiterate his position as one of the word’s most feared bowlers in the first game while Hazelwood was equally destructive with 3-11 from six overs. Australia won by 133 runs.

Hazlewood is hoping for a berth at the T20 World Cup later this year having also been one of Australia’s best in the five matches against the West Indies last week.


#Starc #Hazlewood #WIvAUS
